title: Employer Portal Terms: Monthly Census, Program Changes, Rebanding and Renewal (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
**Census.** The employer reports one census per calendar month for its Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, with its eligible headcount; the month's enrolled active workers and measured availability are added from Paystride's own records, and a corrected census replaces nothing already billed.

**Change requests.** Program changes arrive as change requests from the employer's portal or a desk call and take effect only on their effective date.

**Who may request.** A program change or termination notice is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed among the tier's authorized requester roles; the requester's role is the portal role recorded on the change request.

**Program status.** A program change is accepted only while the agreement status is contracted, implementing or live.

**Access percentage and limits.** A requested access percentage must lie between the tier's lowest and highest configurable access percentage and be a multiple of the tier's step. At most the tier's allowance of access percentage changes may be scheduled in any 365 days, counted as the access percentage change requests on the agreement with status scheduled or effective in the 365 calendar days ending on the submission date, and at most the tier's allowance of fee model changes, counted the same way; a request beyond these limits is declined, never partly applied.

**Effective date.** A change takes effect on the first day of the first pay period that begins at least the tier's change lead, in business days, after the submitted date; transfers already booked keep the terms in force when they were booked.

**Payroll groups and remittance method.** A payroll group change sets the payroll group count from the effective date, and groups beyond the included number are billed on the monthly invoice. A remittance method change is limited to the tier's allowed remittance methods.

**Rebanding.** When the tier's rebanding count of consecutive censuses falls outside the tier's headcount band, counting the most recent months in a row whose eligible headcount lies outside that band, the program moves to the tier whose band contains the latest census headcount on the first day of the next billing month, up or down, without a request; when the new tier's highest configurable access percentage is below the configured percentage, the configured percentage is lowered to that maximum.

**Renewal.** On the renewal date a term with no termination notice renews for the tier's renewal term.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Starter program, two access percentage changes already scheduled or effective in the 365 days ending on the submission date, a third requested | declined |
| Request for 55 percent on a Growth program (highest 50) | declined, not reduced to 50 |
| Growth program whose last three censuses show 262, 270 and 281 eligible employees | moves to Professional on the first day of the next billing month |
| Enterprise program configured at 60 percent rebanding to Professional (highest 50) | configured percentage lowered to 50 |
| Request submitted by a finance viewer | not accepted |
